questions.question: What does chapter 23 record besides David's last words?
options: A census of the twelve tribes
A calendar of all of the yearly festivals
A code of laws for the kingdom
A list of David's mighty men (warriors)
questions.answer: A list of David's mighty men (warriors)

questions.question: What daring feat did three of David's mighty men perform?
options: Held a whole field of lentils all alone against the Philistines
Struck down a lion in a pit on a snowy day
Defeated four hundred men in a single fierce battle
Broke through enemy lines to get David water from Bethlehem
questions.answer: Broke through enemy lines to get David water from Bethlehem

questions.question: David poured out the water from Bethlehem to the LORD rather than drink it.
David's elite warriors were known as his _____ men.
Three mighty men broke through enemy lines to bring David water from _____.
